breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard linear bending stress distribution σ(y) = -(M·y)/I, which gives zero stress at the neutral axis (y=0) and linearly varying stress through the depth. It explicitly rejects the incorrect uniform stress assumption from the incomplete prompt, aligning with the ground truth's standard flexure formula approach.
